text:
mira: Opening a small PR to add a concise troubleshooting note + tiny local repro for 429s/timeouts when context limits are hit. Includes a Python SDK retry snippet, a curl repro, and a short migration blurb for context-trim v2.

sam: please include concrete retry numbers (start, max, jitter) and recommend a max_attempts.

mira: suggested: exponential backoff start=200ms, max=5s, jittered, max_attempts=3. Will show trimming oldest messages before retry and an explicit fallback to a quantized model variant.

doc-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999 (tags: err-ref, 429, timeout).

jordan: Add a one-line note clarifying Dedicated vs Hosted concurrency limits and update the old context-trim link to /docs/runtime/context-trim-v2. I'll do a quick copy/link sanity check after lunch.

len: small nit: don't show infinite retries in examples. Also add a short bullet distinguishing "stream interrupted" from "request timed out" for streaming consumers.

mira: done  added bullets and a short streaming comment in the snippet. Ran linter locally and fixed one broken anchor. PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999

sam: :thumbsup: Merge when CI + link-check pass and @jordan gives copy sign-off. Add PR to docs/err-ref/index.md#recent-updates after merge.
